topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stepped into the quiet of the room, the air still and thick. The paper was folded, innocent, on the table where it shouldn’t have been. My eyes traced the lines, words steeped in dreams I never knew were written. A journey across mountains neither of us had spoken of, a river to cross that was more than just water. Each item, a whisper of the future, plans I had not seen. The room seemed smaller now, the walls closer. I set the paper down, careful, as if handling a bird's delicate nest. The world outside the window was different, broader, and yet, I felt trapped, staring at the map of a life I hadn’t fully understood.
